keyPoints: Parimiti (perimeter) kisi band aakaar ke chaaron taraf ki kul doori hai — aayat ki parimiti = 2 x (lambai + chaudai) — chaaron bhujaon ka yog bhi yahi deta hai.
Varg ki parimiti = 4 x bhuja; samabahu tribhuj ki parimiti = 3 x bhuja.
Kshetrafal (area) aakaar ke andar ki satah ka naap hai — aayat ka kshetrafal = lambai x chaudai.
Varg ka kshetrafal = bhuja x bhuja; 1 cm bhuja wale varg ka kshetrafal 1 varg cm hota hai.
Parimiti ki ikai cm, m hoti hai jabki kshetrafal ki ikai varg cm, varg m — dono ko kabhi mat milao.
Khet ki fencing ke liye parimiti aur farsh par tiles ke liye kshetrafal nikaalte hain — taar ki lambai parimiti se, tiles ki ginti kshetrafal se milti hai.
Aam galti: kshetrafal nikalte samay lambai aur chaudai ki ikai alag hona — pehle dono ko ek hi ikai me badlo, jaise m ko cm me.

title: Parimap: Parimiti aur Kshetrafal
